news.title: Man arrested for 2019 Atlanta house party shooting that left 1 dead
news.summary: A suspect wanted in connection with a deadly March 2019 shooting in Atlanta was arrested Wednesday in Roanoke, Alabama, according to police.

news.title: Young brothers killed in DeKalb Co. quadruple shooting identified
news.summary: Brothers Jamarion Rolle, 11, and Jahki Clark, 12, were killed in a shooting at a Stone Mountain apartment complex.

news.title: 3 alleged gang members arrested in Atlanta summer crime crackdown
news.summary: Georgia prosecutors secured guilty pleas and sentences for three men tied to a Los Angeles-based street gang following an extensive multi-agency investigation in Atlanta.

news.title: 2 boys killed, 2 women injured in deadly shooting at Stone Mountain home, police say
news.summary: Police said that 11-year-old and 12-year-old boys were tragically killed in the shooting that stemmed from a disagreement earlier in the day.

news.title: Falcons quarterback struggles continue in 34-3 loss to Panthers
news.summary: Atlanta fans wanted a change at quarterback on Sunday, but the entrance of undrafted rookie Jack Strand ended in a quick pick-6 during a 34-3 loss to Carolina.
